notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood as replacement for incumbent LLM provider (mainly: OpenAI). Primary intent is migrate from Hosted API -> Dedicated once parity and SLOs are validated.

POC details:
- 2-week Hosted POC started 2026-02-01. Test harness runs 1.2k evaluative prompts (mix of chat, code, and retrieval prompts).
- Metrics: target p50 latency <120ms for short chat requests, p95 <400ms; throughput target ~200 QPS for embedding/rerank pipelines during peak. Cost sensitivity = moderate; looking to reduce per-token costs vs incumbent.
- Progress: Hosted API performance meets latency targets on average, but found prompt-parity regressions (~6% failure/quality delta) focused on tokenization and system-prompt handling when prompts exceed ~1,600 tokens.
- Technical notes: differences traced to tokenization + whitespace normalization and a subtle sampling-seed determinism mismatch in the compat layer. SE team reproduced locally and submitted two repro cases (SUP-4532).
- Requirements called out by Security: SSO (SAML) mandatory, SOC2 Type II required, audit logging + KMS integration for key material, and EU data residency for some customers. They expect VPC peering for Dedicated or Private control plane.
- Business: team prefers Hosted for quick rollout but wants ability to move to Dedicated w/ VPC peering and reserved capacity for predictable throughput. Pricing sensitivity around committed capacity discounts and overage caps.

Quotes / customer voice:
- "We need prompt parity — our QA team can't accept quality regressions even if latency improves." — Head of Product
- "If you can close the parity and give us a migration path, we'll move production in Q2/Q3." — CTO

Next actions (short):
- Schedule Dedicated sizing & VPC peering deep-dive with infra (target week of 2026-03-15).
- SE to deliver patched compat rules + tokenization normalization and re-run the eval set (Jordan).
- Legal to progress DPA review; finance to draft 6/12-month pilot pricing options.

Blockers: prompt parity regressions top priority; legal signoff for DPA; internal budget committee meeting scheduled 2026-03-22.

Links and artifacts: POC evaluation spreadsheet, reproducible prompt cases, pricing deck (drive link), call transcripts (fireflies).
